comments.author: bugs
comments.body_html: i think Realism added its own way of modifying bot loadouts recently? i havent really messed with it because this method is how i do it and how im confident doing it but please do keep in mind this is a pretty ghetto way of doing things, it works well and does what u ask it to do, and maybe theres an easier way of doing it, but i have absolutely no idea what that better method is if it even exists and also im way too autistic to learn it another way — for starters i went to - \user\mods\SPT-Realism\db\bots\loadouts\PMCs - and for now ill focus on usecLO.json . you wanna open it with whatever works, personally i use Notepad++ but all u really need to do is ctrl + F / search for things. — once in the usecLO.json youll find a couple lines called “usecLO1” “usecLO2” etc those are the loadouts per tier, and you modify the item IDs under those tiers, for item IDs i use the tarkov item id finder website which im pretty sure is glued to the SPT website too, be weary it seems some clothing IDs from the item finder site ( clothes are under “body” and “feet” in the jsons ) dont actually work ingame and youll end up with broken bots or scav with invisible pants or top etc. otherwise for modded items just go into the mod folder and look for a db folder with jsons and copy the item IDs from there to put under the matching categories in usecLO.json tiers —heres an exemple adding Openland Hexagon plate carriers to tier 3 USEC bots: —find the artem_vests_json in the artem folder and search for “hexagon” and find the item ID ( in this case its 66326bfd46817c660d015145 ) and copy that ID under “TacticalVest” under “usecLO2” in the useclo json —now USEC bots should spawn with hexagon plate carriers, the 1 in “xx-xx”: 1, represents the weight i think? so how often that item will be spawned, so a weight of 10 while other items have a weight of 2 means that 10 weight item will spawn 5 times more often —theres other things you can modify such as the chance of bots spawning with backpacks helmets etc, and if want those tier2 usec bots to be rarer than all other tiers simply change the tier 2 usec level range somewhere in spawn mods ( for me its all 20% spawn chance for all 5 tiers, givin me a taste of all the ‘factions’ ) —you can repeat this process with AS FAR AS IVE EXPERIMENTED all modded gear items and clothing items (couturier, artem, etc) and always remember to backup your files, and do keep in mind again this is im pretty sure a very ghetto frankenstein way of doing things, ive been doing it that way for a while and its always worked for me, hope this helps
